sentences.zh: 但对一个球员、一个个人而言，这，这，这就是巅峰——首先是代表国家，然后是在世界杯上代表国家参赛。

sentences.en: And it is all, or also to this day, I think players, even, you know, with the money they earn, it doesn't matter representing your country, um, genuinely
sentences.zh: 而且直到今天，我认为球员们，即使你知道他们赚了很多钱，这也没有关系，代表国家参赛，嗯，真的

sentences.en: And then what do you know?
sentences.zh: 结果你猜怎么着？

sentences.zh: 一个星期后他转会去了卢顿，然后也在亲吻那里的队徽。

sentences.en: So there's a degree of, you could say there's a degree of cynicism, but playing for your country when you're singing the anthem, all that stuff.

sentences.en: I mean, does it really, are people cynical about that behind the scenes?
sentences.zh: 我是说，幕后大家真的会对这一点感到虚伪吗？

sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: I don't think sometimes you'll get, you know, when the team's not playing very well, um, particularly in a tournament like that, you'll often get the
sentences.zh: 我不觉得……有时你会发现，当球队战绩不佳时，嗯，特别是在那种大赛中，人们经常会把

sentences.zh: 指责泼到你头上，说你不努力，说他们不努力、拼搏得不够狠。

sentences.en: And it's never that.
sentences.zh: 但从来都不是那样的。

sentences.en: Sometimes it can be that you care too much and you can't, the pressure becomes too much, um, for some players.
sentences.zh: 有时情况可能是你太在乎了，结果压力变得太大，嗯，对于某些球员来说。

sentences.en: Um, but generally every player gives everything, um, to be in this tournament.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但总的来说，每位球员都会倾尽所有，嗯，为了参加这项赛事。

sentences.en: And it's one of those, particularly the World Cup, we've got coming up now is that, you know, we're playing right up to the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 而且这是那种……尤其是我们马上就要迎来的这届世界杯，你知道的，联赛一直踢到世界杯开赛前。

sentences.en: So loads of players are getting injured last minute and missing out, which is a real shame.

sentences.en: So yes, it's, it, I mean, it sounds a bit, a bit pathetic, but you know, to say that it's so important, but it genuinely, genuinely does matter.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这，这——听起来可能有点老套，但你知道的，说它如此重要，然而它实实在在地、真真切切地极其重要。

sentences.en: And it's, it's...
sentences.zh: 而且这，这……

sentences.en: And do you think also a part of that is that, um, it is this kind of regular every four years and each World Cup is remembered and commemorated.
sentences.zh: 你是否也觉得，其中一部分原因在于，嗯，这种每四年举办一次的赛事很固定，每一届世界杯都会被铭记和纪念？

sentences.en: So, you know, that if you pull in a brilliant performance, you will be a part of this, um, folklore, you'll become part of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果你奉献了精彩的表现，你就会成为这种，嗯，传奇的一部分，你会成为历史的一部分。

sentences.en: It's, it's really the best opportunity you have to become internationally significant.
sentences.zh: 这，这真的是你获得国际影响力的最佳机会。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, uh, take my, my own personal situation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，呃，拿我个人的经历来说吧。

sentences.en: When I went, I, my first World Cup that I played in was 86 in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我去参加的我的第一届世界杯是1986年的墨西哥世界杯。

sentences.en: Um, and that transformed my life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那改变了我的人生。

sentences.en: You know, I went into it as a player that was just breaking through, had a couple of good seasons.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我当时去的时候还是一名刚刚崭露头角、踢了几个不错赛季的球员。

sentences.en: Um, you know, won the golden boot in England for Leicester and then Everton.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，在英格兰先是为莱斯特城、然后为埃弗顿赢得过金靴奖。

sentences.en: Um, and then I went to the World Cup and I was known back in England, you know, but, but then I played in the World Cup and I, I finished top
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我去了世界杯，在英格兰国内我也算小有名气，你知道的，但接着我在世界杯上踢了球，并且我最终以

sentences.en: Um, suddenly I was on a plane.
sentences.zh: 嗯，突然之间我就坐上了飞机。

sentences.en: I was on my way to Barcelona to, to sign and play for them for three years.
sentences.zh: 我正在前往巴塞罗那的路上，准备去签约并为他们效力三年。

sentences.en: Um, so it is a, is a thing that can, can launch your career in many ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以这确实是一件能在很多方面开启你职业生涯的事情。

sentences.en: And it certainly did mine.
sentences.zh: 它确实开启了我的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Just that thing about going to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 就是关于去墨西哥这件事。

sentences.en: I mean, for people of, you know, certainly my age and, and Tom's age, a Mexico feels like the sort of the canonical place where you have to have
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于像，你知道的，肯定是我这个年纪以及汤姆这个年纪的人来说，墨西哥感觉就像是一个经典的举办地，你必须在那里办

sentences.en: World Cups because 1970 was in Mexico, the Pelé World Cup, then the Maradona and Lineker World Cup in, uh, in 86.
sentences.zh: 世界杯，因为1970年就在墨西哥，那是贝利的世界杯，然后是86年马拉多纳和莱因克尔的世界杯。

sentences.en: I think just the Maradona World Cup.
sentences.zh: 我想那应该只是马拉多纳的世界杯吧。

sentences.en: Well, it's good to butter up the guests, isn't it, Tom?
sentences.zh: 嗯，讨好嘉宾是个好习惯，对吧，汤姆？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So Mexico, but, but, uh, somebody from, as you say, from Leicester, the market trading background, all that stuff to go to Mexico, which basically British people
sentences.zh: 所以是墨西哥，但是，但是，呃，作为一个正如你所说出身于莱斯特城、有着市场交易背景、经历过这一切的人，要去到墨西哥——那个基本上英国人

sentences.en: didn't go to,
sentences.zh: 都不会去的地方，

sentences.en: I mean, was, did that, were you just so much in the football bubble that you didn't kind of notice or did it, was it as mad and outlandish as it kind of sounds?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这，你当时是完全沉浸在足球泡沫里而没有注意到，还是说它真的像听起来那样疯狂而离奇？

sentences.en: Um, it, it was really, but at the time you, as you quite rightly say, you are in a bubble and we did go there the
sentences.zh: 嗯，它确实非常疯狂，但当时正如你非常正确地指出的那样，你身处一个泡沫之中，而且我们确实在前一年

sentences.en: year before to, to compete in a little mini tournament just to try and acclimatize, get a feel, acclimatize, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 去过那里，参加了一场小型的迷你锦标赛，只是为了尝试适应环境、找找感觉，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And obviously, you know, Mexico at that stage is what I've, I mean, I've watched these series of Narcos, you know, and that it's like, I had no idea that was
sentences.zh: 很显然，你知道的，那时的墨西哥就像我后来……我的意思是，我看过《毒枭》这部剧，你知道的，当时我根本不知道

sentences.en: going on that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 那里正在发生那种类型的事。

sentences.en: You know, mass killings and the drug wars and the cartels and all this stuff was in its height at that particular point.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大规模谋杀、毒品战争和贩毒集团，所有这些在当时都正处于顶峰。

sentences.en: And I used to wonder, I remember when we were there, I wonder why we had this amazing kind of security details with outriding bikes and massive
sentences.zh: 我以前常常纳闷，我记得我们在那里的时候，我在想为什么我们有这么厉害的安保配置，有开道摩托车和

sentences.en: guns driving around with us everywhere we went.
sentences.zh: 拿着重武器、无论走到哪里都护送着我们的车队。

sentences.en: Um, when I saw that series, it made sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我看到那部剧时，一切都说得通了。

sentences.en: Well, because, because I guess the world then was less globalized, so it was much less connected.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为，因为我猜当时的全球化程度较低，所以联系没有那么紧密。

sentences.en: Countries like Mexico, if you're European, were more foreign, I guess.
sentences.zh: 像墨西哥这样的国家，如果你是个欧洲人，感觉会更加陌生吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: I remember though, it was, I mean, it was a beautiful place.
sentences.zh: 不过我记得，那是个美丽的地方。

sentences.en: Um, and we had to acclimatize and it's because of a lot of Mexico's quite high, like altitude, Mexico city, for example, where we ended up playing last 16 in the quarter final.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们必须去适应环境，这是因为墨西哥很多地方海拔相当高，比如墨西哥城，我们最后就是在那里踢了十六分之一决赛和四分之一决赛。

sentences.en: Prior to that though, we, we had to play in Monterey, which was a lot lower, but it was incredibly hot.
sentences.zh: 不过在此之前，我们必须在蒙特雷比赛，那里的海拔低得多，但天气极其炎热。

sentences.en: We played three games there in, in the daytime.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里白天踢了三场比赛。

sentences.en: I think two of the games were at midday and one at four o'clock, or it might be in the other way around, but we were playing in 40 odd degrees centigrade.
sentences.zh: 我想其中两场是正午踢的，一场在四点钟踢，或者可能顺序相反，但我们是在四十多度的高温下踢球。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, nowadays they would, I don't know whether they'd even allow that.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，放在现在，我不知道他们是否还会允许这样做。

sentences.en: It should be too dangerous, but, um, it was, and we, so we had to acclimatize and we went, we went before we went to, um, Colorado for altitude training, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 这应该太危险了，但是，嗯，确实如此，所以我们必须适应环境，我们在去之前先去了，嗯，科罗拉多进行高原训练等等。

sentences.en: But we also had to train for the extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 但我们还得为极端炎热的天气进行训练。

sentences.en: And I remember we used to, Bobby Robson decided that we should all train in a steam room.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们当时，鲍比·罗布森决定让我们都在蒸汽房里训练。

sentences.en: So we were doing all press-ups and jump squats and all these things in a steam room to get used to playing in that heat.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在蒸汽房里做俯卧撑、跳蹲以及所有这些训练，来适应那种高温环境。

sentences.en: Um, and you were only allowed one call a week home.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且你一周只被允许给家里打一个电话。

sentences.en: Is that true?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, no, obviously no mobile phones back then.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对，没有，那时候显然没有手机。

sentences.en: Um, and you know, sometimes we, we discuss the, the boredom of players pre-World Cup when you spend a few weeks together before the actual thing starts.

sentences.en: Um, so you've got to keep yourself entertained, but yeah, there were no mobile phones, no computer games, no laptops, no any, you know, you does very little to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以你得自己找乐子，但对，当时没有手机，没有电子游戏，没有笔记本电脑，没有那些，你知道的，基本上没什么事可做。

sentences.en: So you had to make a bit of your own entertainment and also getting any kind of phone.
sentences.zh: 所以你得自己找点娱乐活动，而且还要设法打任何种类的电话。

sentences.en: We were allowed one phone call home a week.
sentences.zh: 我们一周只被允许给家里打一个电话。

sentences.en: Um, and the interesting thing was just before the world cup, because I'd done really well with Everton, there was a little bit of interest from, from Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有趣的是，就在世界杯开赛前，因为我在埃弗顿表现得非常好，巴塞罗那对我产生了一点兴趣。

sentences.en: Um, and I had a conversation with my agent before I went and I, and, and I said, right, I'm going to the world cup.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在出发前和我的经纪人谈过，然后，我跟他说，好吧，我要去踢世界杯了。

sentences.en: I don't want any distraction.
sentences.zh: 我不想受到任何干扰。

sentences.en: He went, that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 他回答说，完全正确。

sentences.en: Totally understand.
sentences.zh: 完全理解。

sentences.en: So we get through to the, the quarter final, we beat Paraguay and I'd scored three against Poland.
sentences.zh: 所以我们杀入了四分之一决赛，我们击败了巴拉圭，我对阵波兰时进了三个球，

sentences.en: I scored two against
sentences.zh: 我对阵巴拉圭

sentences.en: Paraguay.
sentences.zh: 进了两个球。

sentences.en: And then we've, we've now got to play against Argentina in the court finals and we're all sitting in the room and someone comes in and says, there's a phone call for
sentences.zh: 然后我们现在要在四分之一决赛中对阵阿根廷，我们都坐在房间里，有人进来对我说，前台有你的

sentences.en: you at reception.
sentences.zh: 电话。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh my God, a phone call.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦天哪，有电话。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: So I go there and I went, hello.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了那里，接起电话说，喂。

sentences.en: He said, it was my agent, John Holmes.
sentences.zh: 对方说，那是我的经纪人约翰·霍姆斯。

sentences.en: It still looks after me to this day.
sentences.zh: 直到今天他还在帮我打理事务。

sentences.en: So he said, um, he said, I know we had an agreement that I wouldn't bother you during the world cup.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，嗯，他说，我知道我们有约定，在世界杯期间我不会打扰你。

sentences.en: He said, but situation has, has arisen.
sentences.zh: 他说，但是出现了一个新情况。

sentences.en: And I think it's only right that I call you about it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我还是有必要跟你打个电话。

sentences.en: He said, I've had Barcelona on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他说，我接到巴塞罗那的电话了。

sentences.en: Cause I'd obviously just scored a few goals.
sentences.zh: 因为我显然刚进了几个球。

sentences.en: They're quite pretty quiet in the start of the tournament when I was hopeless.
sentences.zh: 在赛事刚开始时我表现得很糟糕，当时他们可能挺冷淡的。

sentences.zh: 他必须马上签约并同意加盟。

sentences.en: Otherwise it's off.

sentences.zh: 想象一下如果我在世界杯期间跟巴塞罗那签约，我回国后非得被五马分尸不可。

sentences.en: Um, so, and he went, that's absolutely the answer I needed to hear, but I wanted to tell you.

sentences.en: So yeah, that was my one phone call.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，那就是我仅有的一个电话。

sentences.en: That was just, which is quite remarkable.
sentences.zh: 那简直是……相当引人注目。

sentences.en: I did eventually go to Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 我最终确实去了巴塞罗那。

sentences.en: And that's just before the game against Argentina.

sentences.en: A couple of days before.
sentences.zh: 提前几天。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 所以他帮了我一把。

sentences.en: And we were called Honest Links and Shilts and we do it all this betting.
